messages:
jonathan.k: Hey team — new tenant onboarding (Helios) in me-south-1. We need GPU capacity and network limits raised for account 123456789012. Target go-live Monday 2026-04-05. Requesting p5 and g5 family increases + ENI bump. Anyone already opened the support case? :wave:

parul: I can open the case. Can you list exact instance types + counts, AZ distribution, and a short business justification? AWS support will ask for projected spend.

jonathan.k: Sure — summary below. Please use this in the support ticket.

```text
Quota increase request for account 123456789012
Region: me-south-1
Resources: EC2 On-Demand (GPU families), Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI)
Requested limits:
- p5 family: 10 instances (p5.48xlarge x8 initially, reserve for scale to 10)
- g5 family: 20 instances (g5.12xlarge x16 initially)
- ENIs: 1500 total (to support service networking + sidecars)
Justification: Production inference fleet for Helios (commercial launch). SLA 99.9%, low-latency inference. Will provide PO / billing forecast on request.
```

sanaa: Quick note — request a temporary warm window (7 days) so AWS can place capacity across AZs. Otherwise we may hit placement/ASG issues.

parul: Opening support case now. I need the expected steady-state concurrent sessions and peak burst numbers to include.

jonathan.k: Steady-state ~200 concurrent model sessions, peak ~600 for 10-minute bursts. AZ spread: me-south-1a & me-south-1b. Estimated vCPU footprint ~15k during peak.

parul: Submitted case. AWS case ID: 13012345678. Initial ETA 48h. I added the PO request to expedite.

aws-support-bot: Support reply: "Thanks for the submission. We've routed this to the Capacity Team. Please attach billing/PO or expected monthly spend. We may need AZ distribution confirmation. Typical resolution 72-96 hours depending on available hardware in region"

ashley_infra: I'll attach the PO and ping our partner rep to prioritize allocation. If me-south can't place, we should have fallback plan to a nearby region — but prefer single-region for data locality. :+1:

parul: AWS asked whether we can reduce ENI request by splitting traffic (they recommended 1000 instead of 1500). Also asked for subnet/ENI assignment details. I've sent follow-up.

infra-bot: quota-change: account=123456789012; resource=p5 family; requested=10; status=change_requested; id=CR-20260401-887

parul: Update — AWS provisionally approved p5=10, g5=20, ENI=1200 pending final verification and signed allocation agreement. They've requested a short allocation agreement to confirm expected spend + acceptance of allocation terms.

jonathan.k: Can we also add an IPv4/EIP quota note? Health checks and some vendor integrations will need more EIPs.

parul: Added EIP increase to the case.

aws-support-bot: Final update: "Quota increases applied: p5 -> 10, g5 -> 20, ENI -> 1200. Placement may take 24-48h to realize instances. Case 13012345678 closed."

ashley_infra: Confirmed in AWS console — limits reflect the new values. Kicking off Terraform to create ASGs and launch templates (will instrument gradual ramp).

jonathan.k: Great — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the validation load run on Tue and post results here.
